title: Resolution urging ICE to end ankle monitors on non-criminal immigrants
summary: This resolution honors Pierre Damas Bel, a 20-year-old Haitian student who died after being forced to wear an ICE ankle monitor despite having no criminal record. It calls on US Immigration and Customs Enforcement to stop using ankle monitors and other body-worn electronic devices on immigrants in civil proceedings who have no criminal convictions. It also urges ICE to review its Intensive Supervision Appearance Program caseload to identify and remove such devices from everyone who qualifies.
